entities.name: HashMME
entities.description: A type 4 information element with a length of 10 octets that transfers a 64-bit hash value to the UE. The UE uses this value to verify whether its ATTACH REQUEST or TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message was modified.

entities.name: HashMME IEI
entities.description: Information element identifier for HashMME, located in octet 1 (bits 5-8).

entities.name: Length of HashMME
entities.description: Length indicator field for HashMME, located in octet 2 (bits 1-8).

entities.name: HashMME value
entities.description: 64-bit hash value field spanning octets 3-10. Bit 8 of octet 3 is the most significant bit, and bit 1 of octet 10 is the least significant bit.

entities.name: ATTACH REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by the UE that may be verified using the HashMME value.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by the UE that may be verified using the HashMME value.

entities.name: UE verifies HashMME
entities.description: Condition where the UE checks the MME-calculated HashMME value against its locally calculated value to detect message modification.

relations.description: HashMME information element contains the HashMME IEI identifier field.
HashMME information element contains the Length of HashMME field.
HashMME information element contains the HashMME value field.
Hash verification condition applies to the ATTACH REQUEST message.
Hash verification condition applies to the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message.
Hash verification condition uses the HashMME value for comparison.
